comment.body:
Filed the root-cause fix against the SDK: https://gitea.com/gitea/go-sdk/pulls/870

`MergePullRequest` used `getStatusCode`, which discards the refusal body, so tea received `success=false, err=nil` and could only guess the reason from the PR state. Once that merges, the server's own message surfaces directly in `tea pr merge` (and gitea-cli inherits the fix as it moves merge calls onto this SDK method).

This comment was written with AI assistance (Kimi Code).

comment.body:
Before verifying: is tea being retired in favor of gt? If so, will the Gitea web UI follow? The Code dropdown still offers "Tea CLI" (`tea clone owner/repo`), even on https://gitea.com/gitea/cli, whose README points to `gt repo clone`.

As for this issue, it does not reproduce in gt built from main, tested against a disposable Gitea 1.26.4 (web on :3000, SSH on :2222):

- `gt auth login --host http://localhost:3000` stores no ssh_host; the HTTP port is not copied.
- A `git@localhost:owner/repo` remote resolves to the instance without any setting.
- An `ssh://git@localhost:2222/...` remote fails with a hint to run `gt config set ssh_host localhost:2222 --host http://localhost:3000`, and resolves after that.
- `gt repo clone` over SSH uses the API's ssh_url (`-p 2222`), not :3000.
